name: FMC and What Calgary 2024
information:
Please note: this competition does ***NOT*** feature the 3x3 event. If this is your first competition, please consider the event list closely to determine if this is a good fit for you.
If you would prefer to compete in 3x3, please visit the **[Competitions Page](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada&search=&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list)** to view upcoming competitions in your area.
On the other hand, if you plan to attend this competition, please visit the **[Info Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCandWhatCalgary2024#48414-info)** for important details.
